title: Le futur simple
subtitle: Simple future
review: Imported from the old tense page. Texts and examples are the old ones; the level is a guess.
intro: Describes future actions, predictions, promises, and intentions. More formal than the futur proche, and required after temporal conjunctions like *quand* and *dès que* when referring to the future.

examples.en: He will leave tomorrow morning.

examples.fr: Nous **finirons** le projet la semaine prochaine.
examples.en: We will finish the project next week.
She will find an apartment soon.
They will sell their house next year.

blocks.label: Prediction
blocks.title: What will be true in the future

examples.en: The weather will be nice this weekend.
One day, everything will be better.
It will take time.
The results will be available on Friday.
I will be on time, I promise.
We will come back to see you.
I will never forget this moment.
You will have my answer tomorrow.

blocks.label: After quand / dès que
blocks.title: Temporal conjunctions referring to the future

examples.en: When you arrive, call me.
As soon as he's done, we can leave.
I'll write to you when I've arrived.
We'll celebrate as soon as you get back.

blocks.title: Regular conjugation patterns
points: -ER → keep full infinitive : *parler* → je parlerai, tu parleras, il parlera, nous parlerons, vous parlerez, ils parleront.
-IR → keep full infinitive : *finir* → je finirai, tu finiras, il finira, nous finirons, vous finirez, ils finiront.
-RE → drop the final **-e**, then add endings : *vendre* → je vendrai, tu vendras, il vendra, nous vendrons, vous vendrez, ils vendront.
blocks.note: The futur simple always uses the same six endings regardless of verb group. For -RE verbs, drop the final -e before adding them.

blocks.title: Common irregular stems
blocks.formula:
être → ser-    avoir → aur-
aller → ir-     faire → fer-
venir → viendr-   voir → verr-
pouvoir → pourr-   vouloir → voudr-
savoir → saur-    devoir → devr-

examples.en: I will be there at ten o'clock.
She will need help.
We will go to the market.
You will see how beautiful it is.
You will be able to leave after the meeting.

blocks.text: demain, après-demain, bientôt, un jour, la semaine prochaine, le mois prochain, l'année prochaine, dans [time], quand, lorsque, dès que, aussitôt que, tant que …

examples.en: I will not come this evening.
He will never tell the truth.
We will no longer work together.
Will you come tomorrow?
Will he be able to help us?
Will you have the time?

examples.fr:
**Futur proche**: Immediate or planned — felt as certain, tied to the present.
*Je vais partir dans cinq minutes.*
examples.en: I'm going to leave in five minutes.

examples.fr:
**Futur simple**: More distant, formal, or less certain; required after *quand / dès que / lorsque*.
*Je partirai quand j'aurai fini.*
examples.en: I will leave when I have finished.
